title: XAI-AMLBench: Synthetic Multi-Hop Money-Laundering Transaction-Graph Dataset
description: The synthetic transaction-graph dataset generated by XAI-AMLBench's aml_synth module: accounts and transactions embedding five money-laundering typologies (structuring/smurfing, layering, shell-company fan-out/fan-in, round-tripping, and rapid pass-through), built for benchmarking multi-hop graph-based AML detection. Released under CC BY 4.0, separately from the MIT-licensed detection and explainability code -- see CITATION.cff for citing the software itself. Regenerate with: python -m aml_synth.graph_generator --out data --to csv
notes: Zenodo's GitHub integration reads this file at release time to populate the dataset's own citation record, separate from CITATION.cff (which covers the software).
